title: Design System: Florencia — Estudio y obra

display.purpose: Painter's name overlay and page titles; used at most once per page.

title.purpose: Work card titles and the work-detail title.

label.purpose: Plate numbers, year, medium, dimensions, availability, language switch, section labels in the studio letter.

shadows.name: work-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Soft upward drift on work-card hover. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-studio
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (nav underline, button hover).

motion.name: ease-rise
motion.purpose: Easing for the one authored entrance moment — the lead text fades into view.

motion.name: dur-mid
motion.purpose: Mid-paced transitions (nav underline, work card hover).

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: The one authored entrance moment (lead text rise).

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Work-detail single-column breakpoint; nav stays full.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Reference desktop width for captures; work grid is three-up.

components.description: The primary call to action: contact, inquiry, view all work.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: #6E2A2A; color: #F4ECDB; border: 1px solid #6E2A2A; font-family: Karla, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #B85C3F; border-color: #B85C3F; color: #F4ECDB; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.css: .ds-work-card { display: block; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-work-card__media { background: #F4ECDB; border: 1px solid #E2D6BF; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; position: relative; transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-work-card__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-work-card:hover .ds-work-card__media { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(42, 26, 18, 0.6); } .ds-work-card__plate { position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; top: 0.75rem; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #6B5848; background: color-mix(in srgb, #EDE3D2 80%, transparent); padding: 2px 0.5rem; } .ds-work-card__title { font-family: Source Serif 4, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.375rem; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: #2A1A12; margin-top: 0.75rem; } .ds-work-card__sub { font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6B5848; margin-top: 0.25rem; } .ds-work-card__sub--status { color: #6E2A2A; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; background: color-mix(in srgb, #EDE3D2 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #A38C6B 40%, transparent); } .ds-nav__inner { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; } .ds-nav__brand { font-family: Source Serif 4, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #2A1A12; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav__link { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #2A1A12; text-decoration: none; position: relative; } .ds-nav__link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -6px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav__link:hover::after, .ds-nav__link[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav__link[aria-current="page"] { color: #6E2A2A; } .ds-lang { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: baseline; font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-lang a { color: #6B5848; text-decoration: none; } .ds-lang a:hover, .ds-lang a[aria-current="true"] { color: #6E2A2A; } .ds-lang__sep { color: #A38C6B; }

components.css: .ds-label { font-family: JetBrains Mono, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6B5848; display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-input { font-family: Karla, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #2A1A12; background: #F4ECDB; border: 1px solid #A38C6B; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 0; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #6E2A2A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #6E2A2A 25%, transparent); }

narrative.northStar: The Atelier — the painter's working studio as the page.
narrative.overview: The site is the painter's studio before it is a portfolio. The first viewport is a wall with stacked canvases, a paint-stained floor, brushes in a jar, and late-afternoon light through a tall window. The painter's name — "Florencia" — sits in a quiet corner of the scene, not above it. From there, the visitor moves into the work, the painter's letter, and the contact surface; everything carries the same restraint as the room. This is not a marketplace and not a stock-art gallery. The interface recedes. There are no stock decorations, no hero metric, no kicker above a heading, no glass, no gradient text, no card-of-icon-rows. The page is bone-and-putty with one saturated accent (oxblood) that earns its place by being rare. The typography pairs a sober contemporary serif (Source Serif 4) with a working grotesk (Karla) and a technical mono (JetBrains Mono) reserved for plate numbers, year, medium, dimensions, and labels — the kind of typography an art catalogue uses, not the kind a marketing page uses.
keyCharacteristics: The studio is the page; the work emerges from it.
One voice, one room, one accent.
The catalogue speaks in plate numbers, not hashtags.
Bilingual ES/EN by per-route URLs, with equal first-class surfaces.
Honest placeholders for biography, CV, and press — never invented text.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The system carries one saturated accent (oxblood). It appears on ≤10% of any viewport. Every secondary accent is in dialogue with the primary (terracotta as the hover, never as a peer).

rules.name: The No-Default-Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is not gray; it is `ink-soft`, a warm-brown desaturated from ink. Cool grays are wrong against bone.

rules.name: The Plate-Number Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on technical metadata: plate numbers, year, medium, dimensions, availability, and the language switch. It is never used as decoration; it is never used for body copy.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted-Face Rule
rules.body: Every face is self-hosted via `@fontsource`. No Google Fonts CDN. No system-display-face-as-display-voice. If Source Serif 4 fails to load, the fallback is `Iowan Old Style`, then Georgia, then serif — never the platform sans.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker sits above a heading. The heading carries its own weight. Plate numbers live inline with the title as a small bordered badge, never as a heading kicker.

rules.name: The First Heading Rule
rules.body: More space above a heading than below it. Headings breathe at the top of a section, not at the bottom of the previous one.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow in the system is the work-card hover lift, which is a state response, not a baseline. No `box-shadow` on the nav, the footer, the page heads, or the inputs.

rules.name: The One-SVG-Language Rule
rules.body: Imagery is hand-authored SVG. Every painting is its own SVG composition. The studio scene is a single SVG. There are no clip-path approximations of organic shapes; there are no stock icons standing in for drawn marks.

dos: Do keep the studio first viewport intact — stacked canvases, paint-stained floor, brushes in a jar, late-afternoon light.
Do give every painting a museum-grade caption: title, year, medium, dimensions, availability.
Do treat the language switch as a primary navigation element; both locales are equal.
Do let placeholder content stay honest. Empty bio, CV, and press are placeholders, not lorem ipsum.
Do keep one motion moment — the studio rises into view on load — and let everything else stay still.
Do source and self-host the faces; no Google Fonts CDN, no system display faces as the page voice.
donts: Don't add a kicker, eyebrow, or category label above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.
Don't introduce a saturated color besides oxblood and terracotta. No second brand accent.
Don't use system fonts as the display voice. Source Serif 4 (or its fallback chain) only.
Don't introduce a radius. The whole system is sharp-cornered.
Don't use JetBrains Mono outside technical metadata (plate numbers, year, medium, dimensions, availability, language switch).
Don't introduce gradients, glass, blur-as-decoration, or hero-metric scaffolding.
Don't fabricate biography, CV entries, press quotes, or collector names. Honest placeholders only.
Don't lock the painter's medium or stylistic register into the visual system. The studio is medium-neutral by design.
